decision: Browser traffic goes through Vercel: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is the web origin and next.config.js rewrites /api/auth/* and /v1/* to API_URL (Render). The Next.js server calls API_URL directly (env.serverApiUrl). BETTER_AUTH_URL, APP_URL and CORS_ORIGINS on the API are the web origin; COOKIE_DOMAIN unset.
why: vercel.app and onrender.com are different sites: a cookie set directly by the API is third-party and SameSite=Lax never sends it back; SameSite=None would fail in Safari. First-party through a same-origin rewrite is the template's own commented plan.
evidence: apps/web/next.config.js, apps/web/env.ts, apps/web/lib/hono-server.ts, apps/web/app/(auth)/layout.tsx, turbo.json (API_URL listed so strict env mode passes it to next build)
